review_policy: Automation detects and drafts. A person approves public claims, directory changes, contact details, funding terms, deadlines, rates, and civic guidance.

action_queue.label: national funding pages waiting for claim review
action_queue.next_action: Open each official page and confirm deadlines, eligibility, award range, application cost, fiscal-sponsor rules, and allowed uses before changing the public funding directory.

action_queue.label: priority directory candidates
action_queue.next_action: Confirm each linked listing page before adding it to canonical data.

action_queue.label: confirmed broken resource-discovery hubs
action_queue.next_action: Replace or intentionally retire each hub URL before relying on its candidate queue.

action_queue.label: resource candidate links waiting for review
action_queue.next_action: Review the highest-scoring links, confirm current public details and terms of use, then add only useful entities or programs to canonical data.

action_queue.label: canonical rows without a website or source URL
action_queue.next_action: Enrich high-value entries first; do not invent contact paths.

action_queue.label: listing keyword sets proposed for review
action_queue.next_action: Review additions and removals in the latest keyword-sweep report before merging the keyword index.

action_queue.label: free-tool or nonprofit-offer pages waiting for wording review
action_queue.next_action: Confirm current free-plan limits, nonprofit eligibility, geographic availability, and provider terms before changing the public tool inventory.

action_queue.label: listings without an identified promotion route
action_queue.next_action: Enrich these only when a public page or direct contact supports a useful route; do not invent availability.

action_queue.label: keyword source pages needing attention
action_queue.next_action: Open failed pages normally before removing retained source-derived keywords.

action_queue.label: national funding pages needing a normal-browser check
action_queue.next_action: Open these pages normally; do not treat bot blocking or a temporary network error as a closed program.

action_queue.label: free-tool pages needing a normal-browser check
action_queue.next_action: Open failed pages normally; do not remove a tool solely because automation was blocked or timed out.

action_queue.label: resource-discovery hubs needing a normal-browser check
action_queue.next_action: Open these pages normally; do not remove a source because of bot blocking or a temporary request failure.

action_queue.label: offline posting pathways awaiting a field check
action_queue.next_action: Confirm the physical location or owner-controlled posting policy locally.

action_queue.label: free-tool candidate links waiting for review
action_queue.next_action: Open each official candidate and add it only when it fills a real guide task without duplicating an existing tool.
